personality_one_liner: A trustworthy, clean, and highly readable iOS-native interface tailored for academic focus, utilizing a calming botanical sage palette to evoke medical professionalism.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Apply to sticky headers over scrolling content
Apply to bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Apply frosted glass overlay to Hero course cards
dont's: Do not apply to form fields or list rows
Do not stack more than 2 blur surfaces per screen

screens.name: Auth & Onboarding
screens.purpose: Allow students and teachers to create accounts, select their roles, and login.

states.error: Toast or inline message with retry button.

screens.layout: Clean top-down form. Use segmented control for Role (Student / Teacher). Submit button sticky at the bottom.

screens.name: Home (Course Marketplace)
screens.purpose: Allow students to discover, search, and filter medical courses by Year, Wilaya, and Specialty.

states.empty: Illustration of a blank notebook (online learning blank state) + 'No courses found for this filter.'

screens.layout: Top section: Search bar + sticky horizontal scrollable chips for filters (Wilaya, Year 1-7). Below: 2-column grid of course cards. Cards show title, instructor, and subtle rating badge.

screens.name: Course Detail
screens.purpose: Provide comprehensive course info to convince students to request enrollment.

states.loading: Skeleton of hero and tabbed list.

screens.layout: Hero image with vertical gradient-to-dark scrim, large title, rating. Below hero: segmented control (Curriculum, Reviews). Curriculum is an accordion list of lessons. IMPORTANT: Sticky 'Request Enrollment' button at the bottom safe-area in a glass container.

screens.name: Checkout (Payment Request)
screens.purpose: Guide students through the manual payment process via CCP/BaridiMob.
screens.layout: Step 1: Course Summary. Step 2: Teacher's CCP/BaridiMob Account Details displayed prominently in a brandTertiary tinted card. Step 3: 'Upload Receipt' button (opens image picker). Step 4: Sticky 'Submit Request' button at bottom.

screens.name: Teacher Dashboard
screens.purpose: Let teachers manage their courses and approve/reject enrollment requests.
screens.layout: Tabbed view: 'My Courses' (list) & 'Pending Requests' (list of students who uploaded receipts). Each request row has an 'Approve' (brandPrimary) and 'Reject' (surfaceTertiary) action button.

screens.name: Lesson Viewer
screens.layout: Video thumbnail linking out to YouTube/Drive (if external) or embedded video player. Below: Scrollable text content area with generous editorial spacing.

screens.name: AI Study Assistant
screens.purpose: Chat interface for students to ask medical doubts.

states.empty: Welcome message with suggested medical prompts.

screens.layout: Standard chat layout. Bubbles: user (brandTertiary), AI (surfaceSecondary). Sticky input field at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage user info and toggle language (Arabic/French).
screens.layout: List layout. Avatar at top. Toggle row for Language (AR/FR) which triggers RTL switch. Logout button at bottom.

empty_courses.alt: Blank notebook on a desk for empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality guidelines. Avoid heavy shadows and dense dashboards.
BANNED COLORS: Do not use any blues, indigos, purples, or teals. The primary brand color is a Medical Forest Green (#14532D).

RTL & BILINGUAL SUPPORT: The app requires Arabic (Default, RTL) and French (LTR). Use React Native's I18nManager.forceRTL() conditionally, or apply standard flex layout properties (e.g., flex-start/flex-end) that adapt natively to I18nManager direction.
MANUAL PAYMENT FLOW: The checkout is NOT a Stripe integration. It must show Teacher's CCP/BaridiMob info, and include a file/image picker for the student to upload the receipt.
MARKETPLACE HOME: Implement sticky horizontal filter chips for Wilaya (1-58) and Study Year (1-7) below the search bar.
COURSE DETAIL: Always use a vertical gradient-to-dark scrim over the hero image to ensure the course title is readable (WCAG contrast).
STICKY CTA: Ensure the 'Request Enrollment' button is sticky at the bottom of the Course Detail screen, floating above the scrollable curriculum.
